messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: ALERT FIRED -> hosted-inference-prod | POLICY: inference-hosted-escalation
incident-bot: Severity: P2, Condition: high 5xx rate on gpu-pool-02, recent rate 4.8% (threshold 1%). Incident key: pd_abcdef123456. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/high-5xx
pd-bot: Escalation: primary did not acknowledge within 60s. Routing to secondary: tasha (secondary oncall).
alex (oncall): ugh, laptop stuck on login. VPN flaky. trying to get in to ack PD console, give me 2m :grimacing:
alex (oncall): checking logs now, seeing nginx upstream 502s spiking on gpu-pool-02
tasha (secondary): got page. i'm at home, phone on airplane mode earlier — pulling PD now. can someone paste recent error sample?
incident-bot: Recent error snippet (last 5m):
```
503 POST /v1/generate  - upstream read timeout
model: redwood-v2-7b, host: gpu-node-17, traceback: kv-cache miss spike
```
jess (support): customer-facing: we have ~18 customers with elevated errors (region: us-west), most are queued errors, some 503s. CS is triaging tickets.
pd-bot: Secondary (tasha) did not acknowledge within 120s; escalating to manager: mohit.
mohit (manager): pinged. oncall rotation said primary trying to escalate. i'm awake, jumping in. please post current mitigation steps and I'll join Zoom if needed. :phone:
sam (sre): quick summary: autoscaler failed to spin extra pods on gpu-pool-02 due to kube-scheduler hit 'node affinity conflict'. I can attempt manual scale-up: `kubectl scale --replicas=+3 deployment/gpu-inference -n hosted`
alex (oncall): frank update — I can access console now, but PD action didn't go through from laptop window. I can ack if you'd like me to take.
mohit (manager): tasha, if you can ack in PD we should keep primary remote-safe. otherwise i'll ack and coordinate.
tasha (secondary): my PD mobile was spamming earlier but the app froze during the first page, restarting it now. ack'ing in PD. :white_check_mark:
pd-bot: Acknowledged by tasha (secondary) at 1822003420. Escalation halted.
incident-bot: Action plan suggested by runbook: 1) manual scale up pool 2) restart inference service on affected nodes 3) monitor 5xx rate for 10m
sam (sre): running scale command now. paste command outputs:
```
$ kubectl scale deployment/gpu-inference --replicas=12 -n hosted
deployment.apps/gpu-inference scaled
```
sam (sre): triggering rolling restart for affected node set: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gpu-inference -n hosted --selector=zone=us-west-2a`
alex (oncall): watching metrics — token latency dropping, 5xx trending down from 4.8% -> 1.7% after scale
jess (support): CS update: posting temporary status page note: "We are investigating increased 503s for hosted inference in US-WEST. Partial mitigation in progress." link: https://status.redwood/status/INC-1822003333
tasha (secondary): monitoring logs; seeing a flurry of KV-cache eviction logs during the spike. adding note to postmortem.
mohit (manager): good. once 5xx <1% for 10m, we'll resolve and run a quick postmortem. Alex/Tasha/Sam — can one of you take lead on RCA timeline?
alex (oncall): I'll own the immediate RCA timeline. will collect node logs and autoscaler events.
incident-bot: Incident metrics snapshot: peak 5xx: 4.8%, impacted requests: ~12k over 7m, partial customer impact (18 customers), fallback to smaller model observed for 3% of requests.
mohit (manager): assigning postmortem owner: alex. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up and ping legal if any enterprise SLAs could be affected.
jess (support): CS will send templated customer note once we have final mitigation timestamp.
pd-bot: Incident resolved automatically? No — manual resolve pending.
tasha (secondary): i'm marking my PD acknowledgement to clear alerts if they drop below threshold.
sam (sre): 5xx is holding at 0.6% for last 2m. starting a 10m observation window.
alex (oncall): collecting logs now and will upload to runbook folder. link when ready.
mohit (manager): thanks all. great handoff — closing Slack thread when incident resolved and RCA draft is ready. :thumbsup:
